Speed: Speed is a status effect that causes entities to move faster on foot.
Sticky: Sticky is a joke status effect in Java Edition 24w14potato.
Strength: Strength is a status effect which increases attack damage.
Trial Omen: Trial Omen is a variant of the Bad Omen effect, which is granted when a non-ominous trial spawner enters the line of sight of a player with Bad Omen. Trial Omen causes nearby trial spawners to become ominous trial spawners.
Water Breathing: Water Breathing is a status effect that prevents or delays drowning, and allows waterlogged beds‌[Bedrock Edition  only] to be used. In Bedrock Edition, it additionally prevents or delays squid, glow squid, salmon, cod, pufferfish, tropical fish, nautilus, and tadpoles from taking suffocation damage when they are not in water, and also prevents players/mobs from taking suffocation damage inside full, solid, non-transparent blocks.
Weakness: Weakness is an effect that decreases attack damage. It is required to cure zombie villagers.
Weaving: Weaving is a status effect that lessens the movement speed decrease from being in a cobweb, as well as causing cobwebs to be placed upon death.
Wind Charged: Wind Charged is a status effect that causes an entity to release a burst of wind upon death.
Wither (effect):
Wither is a status effect that inflicts damage over time. It acts similarly to Poison, save for the fact that it acts slower, can do so against the undead, and can kill on any difficulty level. It also turns the player's health bar black, making their health harder to track.
It can be cured by drinking milk.
Invisibility: Invisibility is a status effect that turns players and mobs completely transparent and see-through, but has no effect on held items, worn armor, or certain parts of some mobs. Invisible entities, especially those wearing no armor, can get significantly closer to most mobs without being detected.
It's very slippery:
It's very slippery is a status effect from Java Edition 24w14potato.
The effect does nothing, and does not have an assigned texture.
Jump Boost: Jump Boost is a status effect that increases the jumping height of the bearer.
Levitation: Levitation is a status effect inflicted by shulker bullets that causes entities to uncontrollably float upward.
Luck: Luck is a status effect found exclusively in Java Edition and Legacy Console Edition that increases the chances of receiving better loot from certain loot tables. It is opposite to Bad Luck. The only loot table influenced by luck is fishing.
Mining Fatigue: Mining Fatigue is an effect that reduces mining efficiency and attack speed, opposite to Haste.
Nausea: Nausea is an effect that temporarily warps and wobbles the player's vision similarly to a Nether portal. In Java Edition, the "Distortion Effects" setting can reduce the intensity of the wobbling (or stop it completely), substituting it with green-tinted vision.
Night Vision: Night Vision is a status effect that enhances the player's ability to see in darkness and underwater.
Oozing: Oozing is a status effect that causes an entity to spawn two medium-sized slimes upon death.
Poison: Poison is an effect that inflicts damage over time. It is similar to Wither, but it drains health faster and it cannot kill (it does, however, reduce the player's health all the way to 1HP).
Potion: Potions are bottled consumable liquids that give effects for a certain amount of time when drunk. They are primarily obtained from brewing. Every potion is brewed starting from a water bottle, which is considered a type of potion that has no effects.
Raid Omen: Raid Omen is a status effect that causes raids to start.
Regeneration: Regeneration is a status effect that restores an entity's health over time.
Resistance: Resistance is a status effect that reduces incoming damage.
Saturation (effect): Saturation is a status effect that restores hunger and saturation‌[JE  only].
Sharing: Sharing is a joke effect from Java Edition 15w14a which replaces the data value of the Weakness effect.
Shazboots! (effect): Shazboots! is a joke status effect in Java Edition 25w14craftmine.
Slow Falling: Slow Falling is a status effect that causes midair entities to more gradually descend downward and avoid fall damage, but prevents critical hits and smash attacks.
Slowness: Slowness is a status effect that decreases walking speed. As such, it is also the opposite of Speed.
Small:
Small is a joke effect that reduces the size of entities, added in April Fools' snapshot 23w13a_or_b. Bosses are immune to the effect.
It is the counterpart to Big.
Absorption: Absorption is a status effect that pads the health bar with extra hearts.
Bad Luck: Bad Luck, also known as Unluck, is a status effect found exclusively in Java Edition and Legacy Console Edition that decreases the chance of the player getting high-quality loot, contrary to Luck.
Bad Omen: Bad Omen is a status effect only obtainable from consuming an ominous bottle. It can transform into Raid Omen in a village to start a raid, or into Trial Omen when seen by a non-ominous trial spawner, to start an ominous trial.
Big:
Big is a joke effect that increases the size of entities, added in 23w13a_or_b.
It is the counterpart to Small.
Blindness: Blindness is a status effect that impairs a player's vision and prevents sprinting and critical hits. It has no potion, but it can be obtained by consuming suspicious stew made with an azure bluet or open eyeblossom.
Breath of the Nautilus: Breath of the Nautilus is a status effect that is granted while riding a nautilus or zombie nautilus which prevents the rider's oxygen bar from depleting.
Caring: Caring is a joke effect from Java Edition 15w14a which replaces the data value of both Slowness and Poison effects.
Conduit Power: Conduit Power is an area-of-effect status effect given by active conduits to players touching water or rain. It grants a combination of Water Breathing, Haste, and Night Vision.
Darkness: Darkness is a status effect that impairs a player's vision. It is caused by the activation of a naturally-generated sculk shrieker, or by being within detection range of a warden.
Dolphin's Grace: Dolphin's Grace is a status effect that increases an entity's speed while they are in water. It is obtained by sprint-swimming while a dolphin is nearby.
Fatal Poison: Fatal Poison inflicts damage to entities over time, and can kill both undead and non-undead mobs, similar to Wither. The effect is actually called "Poison," but its ID distinguishes it from the other Poison effect, which cannot kill. In Survival mode, the effect applies only to parrots (when feeding them a cookie) and is not obtainable by players.
Fire Resistance: Fire Resistance is a status effect that grants the affected entity complete immunity to all sources of fire damage.
Glowing: Glowing is a status effect that shows entity positions through blocks.
Haste: Haste is a status effect that increases mining efficiency and attack speed.‌[Java Edition  only]
Health Boost: Health Boost is an unused status effect that increases maximum health of an entity.
Hero of the Village: Hero of the Village is a player-exclusive status effect obtained by defeating a raid and lasts 40 minutes, during which players receive discounts from villager trades, and in Java Edition, gifts from villagers.
Hunger (effect): Hunger is a status effect which causes hunger and saturation to deplete faster than normal.
Infested: Infested is a status effect that causes an entity to sometimes spawn silverfish upon taking damage.
Instant Damage: Instant Damage is an instant status effect that decreases health for players and living mobs and heals the undead.
Instant Health: Instant Health is an instant status effect that increases health for players and living mobs and damages the undead.
